verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents tracing agent runs through environment variables, framework integrations, SDKs and OpenTelemetry, and lets you inspect threads and runs in Messages, Turns, and Details views. Hands-on community feedback confirms seeing full traces move through the graph with each step's inputs and outputs inspectable. One commenter's vague claim that it shows only LLM inferences is outweighed by this specific first-party and community evidence. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the nested span/run-tree hierarchy and of how runs are grouped into sessions or threads, plus stronger independent corroboration of multi-step nesting outside LangChain.
